full_prompt_en: A square architectural illustration shows a monumental pale stone church beneath an open blue sky, with warm terracotta domes rising above a tightly layered body of arches. The background is a smooth clear blue field, interrupted at the far right by a pale distant mass that remains secondary to the building. A tall narrow bell tower stands behind the left side, its upper arched openings dark beneath a small orange dome. Across the upper center, the largest rounded dome sits on a ring of closely spaced arched windows; its tiled surface carries uneven rusty orange and sunlit ochre marks. Two smaller domes overlap its lower edge, one left of center and one to the right, so the roofline steps forward in several rounded tiers. The central walls are off-white and cool gray, with fine masonry lines and patches of weathered shadow giving the broad surfaces a lightly granular character. Repeated recessed windows and curved arcades cut dark blue-gray openings into the bright stone. At the lower left, a deep entrance arch and a short flight of steps make the building meet the open paved foreground. Another cluster of arches and smaller roof forms extends across the lower center and right, while sparse green shrubs sit close to the foundation. The view is slightly low and frontal, emphasizing the height of the main dome without flattening the side volumes. Crisp sunlight from the upper left catches the curved roofs and projecting stone bands; cooler shadows collect under every arch, inside the windows, and along the rightward recesses. Fine, precise edges describe the structure, while lightly irregular grain and muted outlines keep it from looking like a flat diagram. The overall composition balances a dense rhythm of rounded volumes against generous blue space, joining pale masonry and warm roofs in a calm, luminous architectural study.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形建筑插画呈现晴朗蓝天下一座宏大的浅色石砌教堂，暖陶土色穹顶层层升起，下方是紧密叠合的拱券体量。背景是一片平滑清澈的蓝色，最右侧有一块淡淡的远处形体，但始终从属于建筑。左侧后方立着一座狭高钟塔，顶部的小橙色穹顶下是深色的拱形开口。画面上方中央，最大的圆顶坐落在一圈密集排列的拱窗上；瓦面带有不均匀的锈橙色和受光的赭黄色痕迹。两个较小的穹顶与其下缘重叠，一座在中间偏左，另一座在右边，使屋顶线条以几层圆润的层级向前推进。主体墙面是灰白和冷灰色，细细的石砌线与斑驳阴影让宽阔表面显出轻微颗粒感。重复出现的内凹窗户和弧形拱廊，在明亮石墙中切出深蓝灰色开口。左下方深邃的入口拱券和一小段台阶，将建筑接到开阔的铺地前景。另一组拱券和较小屋面横向延伸过下方中部与右侧，稀疏绿色灌木贴近基座。视点略低而近于正面，突出主穹顶的高度，同时保留侧面体量。左上方清晰的日光照亮弧形屋顶和突出的石质水平带；较冷的阴影聚在每道拱券下、窗内以及右侧退入处。细致明确的边缘勾出结构，而略不规则的颗粒与克制的轮廓又使其不至于像平面图解。整体构图以密集的圆润体量节奏对照充裕蓝色空间，把浅色石墙和暖色屋顶结合成宁静明亮的建筑写生。
style_prompt_en: A precise illustration style builds volume from repeated rounded masses, narrow recessed openings, and crisp bands of shadow. Fine linework gives the edges structural clarity, while slightly grainy, uneven surface marks soften broad planes. Pale ivory and cool gray occupy the largest areas; rusty terracotta and muted ochre sit on raised surfaces, and small blue-gray recesses give the light palette depth. Clear daylight strikes upper and outward-facing planes, leaving compact cool shadows inside cuts and beneath overlaps. Forms step forward in a dense vertical rhythm above a comparatively open lower field, with clean blue negative space releasing the clustered silhouette. The overall effect is luminous and orderly, with weathered texture preventing the geometry from feeling sterile.
style_prompt_zh: 精细的插画表现以反复出现的圆润体块、狭窄内凹开口和清楚的阴影带建立体积。细线让边缘有结构上的明晰度，略带颗粒和不均匀的表面痕迹则柔化宽阔平面。象牙白与冷灰占据最大面积，锈陶土色和柔和赭黄落在隆起的表面，小块蓝灰色凹处为浅色调增加深度。清澈日光照到朝上和朝外的平面，紧凑的冷色阴影留在切口内部和叠合处下方。形体以密集的竖向节奏向前层层递进，下方区域相对开阔，干净的蓝色留白释放聚集的外轮廓。整体效果明亮而有序，风化般的肌理使几何形状不显生硬。
theme_en: A domed stone church beneath a clear blue sky
theme_zh: 晴朗蓝天下的多穹顶石砌教堂
name: Byzantine architecture
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
